title: Puzzle2d Play Panel Toggle Latency
description: Panel toggle in puzzle 2d play still takes ~2s. Finish perf fixes: SidePanel memo, resolveTab cache, ProductShell panel prop memo.
summary:
Panel toggle in puzzle 2d play was still ~2s because SidePanel visibility changes re-rendered full Nakagin document/inspector trees, PlaygroundView recomputed the whole shell on every toggle, and ProductShell canvasNode useMemo was incomplete.

- ui/react: SidePanelTreePane memo so Tree skips reconcile when only visible toggles.
- playground renderer: usePlaygroundViewShellData (data generation only) + chrome-only subscribe in PlaygroundView; assignPanelVisibility for toggles; PureSidePanelTabDefinition caches resolveTab via buildTab.
- platform renderer: finished canvasNode useMemo; ShellModeCanvas memo; assignPanelVisibility in PlatformView toggles.
- framework/core: assignPanelVisibility test (no notify).

Tests: @semio-tech/framework-core 22, @semio-tech/ui-react 87, playground renderer 15 — all pass.
